close.hi: kon kholo ki triangle band ho
close.en: open the angle so the triangle closes

hop.en: land it where the hop ends

beam.en: place the mirrors and run it

circuit.en: wire it up and run it

pendulum.en: set the thread and run it

place.hi: naav us saal tak le jao aur patthar giraao
place.en: take the boat to the year and drop the stone

order.hi: har patthar ko uske saal par giraao
order.en: drop each stone at its year

rail.en: couple the wagons and run the train

multiples.hi: burj ya jaal lagao aur lehar chalao
multiples.en: set the towers or nets and run the wave

factors.en: build the towers and run the wave

lcm.en: set the trap and run the wave

divisibility.hi: jo dushman toot jayenge un par jaal bichhao aur lehar chalao
divisibility.en: net the foes the tower will break and run the wave

locate.hi: drone ko us jagah le jao aur giraao
locate.en: fly the drone to the spot and drop

route.en: plan the route and run it

scale.hi: scale se naapo aur truck chalao
scale.en: measure with the scale and drive the truck

set.hi: suiyan ghuma kar ghadi milao aur ghanti bajao
set.en: turn the hands to the time and ring the bell

run.hi: ghadi ya ticket set karo aur bus chalao
run.en: set the clock or the ticket and run the bus

race.hi: har dhaavak ko podium par rakho aur daud chalao
race.en: put each runner on the podium and run the race

calendar.hi: jhanda us taareekh par lagao aur din ginte jao
calendar.en: plant the flag on the date and hop the days

mirror.hi: aaine ki lakeerein rakho aur modo
mirror.en: lay the mirror lines and fold

tile.hi: tiles ek kone ke chaaron or rakho aur farsh bichhao
tile.en: lay the tiles round the corner and tile the floor

measure.hi: ruler se naapo aur feeta kaato
measure.en: measure with the ruler and cut the ribbon

fence.hi: baad kaato aur bagiche ko ghero
fence.en: cut the fence and go round the garden

trip.hi: meter set karo aur cycle chalao
trip.en: set the meter and ride the trip

compare.hi: raaston ko chhote se bade kram mein rakho aur chalao
compare.en: put the routes from shortest to longest and ride them

thread.hi: dhaaga line ke saath bichhao, seedha karke scale par padho
thread.en: lay the thread along the line, straighten it and read the scale

thermo.hi: thermometer lagao aur uska paimana padho
thermo.en: use the thermometer and read its scale

scale.hi: scale theek se lagao aur seedha upar se padho
scale.en: line up the scale and read it from directly above

touch.hi: chhoo kar dekho, shelf par rakho, phir thermometer se jaancho
touch.en: feel them, put them on the shelf, then check with a thermometer

field.en: cut the field and load the truck

pack.hi: godown ka maal trucks mein barabar baanto
pack.en: share the godown equally into the trucks

story.hi: gaadiyan ya packet rakho aur kahani chalao
story.en: set out the vehicles or packets and run the story

yard.hi: truck mein utne crate rakho jitna number likha hai, ya comma sahi jagah lagao
yard.en: load the truck with exactly the number on the docket, or set its commas

grow.hi: tiles rakh kar agla aakaar banao, ya door ke aakaar ke liye thaila bharo
grow.en: lay tiles to grow the next stage, or fill the bag for a far stage

machine.hi: machine ka niyam set karo aur chalao
machine.en: set the machine's rule and run it

beats.hi: chhote aur lambe beat ki saari laya rakho aur bajao
beats.en: lay every rhythm of short and long beats and play them

nest.hi: tukde varg mein bithao aur bharo
nest.en: fit the pieces into the square and fill it

fold.hi: kaagaz modo, rang bharo aur tukda gino
fold.en: fold the sheet, shade it and count the piece

pour.hi: jug se cup bharo aur bacha hissa naapo
pour.en: pour the jug into cups and name the part cup

grid.hi: grid mein dasvein bharo ya ank khiskao
grid.en: shade the tenths or slide the digits

story.hi: kahani padho, patti modo aur hissa lo
story.en: read the story, fold the bar and take the part

tray.hi: tray ki deewar ya dhakkan lagao aur counter chalao
tray.en: set the tray walls or the lid and run the counter

bin.hi: ek jaise term ek dibbe mein daalo aur dibbe band karo
bin.en: put like terms in one bin and close the bins

build.hi: parkar kholo, nishaan lagao aur tribhuj banao
build.en: open the compass, swing the arcs and build the triangle

bisect.hi: barabar parkar se nishaan lagao aur rekha milao
bisect.en: swing equal arcs and join the crossings

drop.hi: set-square ko saamne ki bhuja par rakho aur lamb kheencho
drop.en: lay the set-square along the opposite side and draw the altitude

tally.hi: har parchi ko uski line mein tally ki tarah lagao aur gino
tally.en: stroke each slip into its row as a tally and count

stack.hi: blocks ko barabar karo ya level ki line lagao
stack.en: level the towers or set the level line

line.hi: cards ko kram mein lagao aur beech mein khoonti rakho
line.en: put the cards in order and set the peg in the middle

pairs.en: load the bags that make the boat's count

magic.hi: har khaane mein ek number rakho, har line ka jod barabar
magic.en: put a number in every cell so every line adds the same

cipher.hi: har akshar ko ek ank do aur jod karo
cipher.en: give each letter a digit and add it up

mirror.hi: shuru ka number set karo, ulta karke jodo
mirror.en: set a start, then reverse and add

tri.hi: kapde ka rectangle ya utna hi farsh bichhao, ya tent ka kona rakho
tri.en: lay the cloth's rectangle or as much floor, or set the tent's corner

solid.hi: ghumao aur har face, edge ya corner par nishaan lagao
solid.en: turn it and mark every face, edge or corner

kaapi.hi: taraazu par jaancho aur pehli galat line pakdo
kaapi.en: check it on the balance and catch the first wrong line
